name: Kids story videos
description: Short, gentle illustrated story videos for young children, narrated in each chosen language. Each run makes a 2 to 3 minute 16:9 episode and a vertical Short per language, with exact subtitles, a thumbnail and upload details. Set your own series name, cast and branding in the settings.

species.description: What kind of animal the character is.
species.title: Species

visual_descriptor.description: Exact visual description repeated in every picture to keep them on model.
visual_descriptor.title: Fixed look

personality.description: How the character behaves and speaks, given to the story writer.

voice_override.description: Voice id used when this character speaks a whole scene. Empty uses the narrator.

refrain.en: Be kind, be brave, be you!
refrain.ta: அன்பாக இரு, துணிவாக இரு, நீயாகவே இரு!

intro_line.en: Hello, little friends! Welcome to {series}. Let's begin!
intro_line.ta: வணக்கம், சின்ன நண்பர்களே! {series} உங்களை அன்புடன் வரவேற்கிறது. கதையைத் தொடங்குவோம்!

outro_line.en: Thank you for listening, little friends. See you in the next story!
outro_line.ta: கதையைக் கேட்டதற்கு நன்றி, சின்ன நண்பர்களே. அடுத்த கதையில் சந்திப்போம்!

editorial_rules: Every story is gentle, warm and safe for children aged three to seven.
No violence, fear, danger, villains, punishment or unsafe behaviour.
Problems are small and everyday, and the friends solve them by being kind.
No brands, products, real people, places of worship or current events.
Use short sentences and simple words a young child understands.

cast.visual_descriptor: a small round baby elephant with soft blue-grey skin, big floppy ears with pink insides, a short curly trunk, bright curious eyes and a red-and-yellow striped scarf
cast.personality: curious, cheerful and caring; asks lots of questions and loves helping friends

cast.visual_descriptor: a little green parrot with a bright red curved beak, a yellow chest patch, blue-tipped wings and a tiny orange flower tucked behind one eye
cast.personality: chatty and funny; loves singing and sometimes talks before thinking

cast.visual_descriptor: a tiny brown palm squirrel with three cream stripes down its back, a big fluffy tail and a small green satchel across its chest
cast.personality: quick, clever and a little shy; good at noticing small things

cast.visual_descriptor: a gentle old tortoise with a domed olive-green shell with honey-coloured patterns, round spectacles and a soft white beard
cast.personality: calm, patient and wise; tells the friends gentle lessons with a smile

story.writing_style: Short sentences, simple everyday words, warm and calm tone.
story.question_style: "What happens next?" style questions for children
morals: Kind words can mend a sad heart.
It is fine to make mistakes if we try again.
Good friends listen to each other.
Small helpers can do big things.

safety.picture_exclusions: text, letters, words, captions, watermark, logo, signature, scary, gloomy, violence, weapons, sharp teeth, distorted faces, extra limbs
